name: H-box fusion
summary: Two H-boxes connected through an arity-2 H-box (a Hadamard) fuse into a single H-box.
description:
Two H-boxes that are connected via an arity-2 H-box fuse into one H-box carrying all the remaining legs. This is the H-box analogue of [spider fusion](../spider-fusion/): just as Z-spiders fuse when connected by a plain wire, H-boxes fuse when they are connected by a wire carrying a Hadamard.

Thinking of an H-box followed by a Hadamard as a multi-input AND gate, the rule says that a tree of ANDs is a single AND gate. The version where one of the H-boxes carries an arbitrary label is [labelled H-box fusion](../zh-h-box-fusion-labelled/).
parameter_notes: n legs on the first H-box and m on the second (shown for n = m = 2); holds for any number of legs.
notes: The H-boxes here are *unnormalised*: an H-box with label $a$ has all entries equal to $1$, except for the entry where all wires are $1$, which is $a$. The grey spiders of the ZH papers are normalised differently from the X-spiders of PyZX, so scalar factors may differ from those in the papers.
